figurative_meaning_en: Means of suicide; aid for drowning to death
similar_in_english: Couldn't hang oneself if one tried
Down to one's last resort in misfortune
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার দুর্ভাগ্য এমন যে দড়িকলসি হাতে এলেও সাহায্য করবে না।
example_sentences_in_english: Even the most unfortunate person can't find a rope or pot for suicide.
His bad luck is such that even means of suicide won't come to hand.
history: This idiom originates from traditional Bengali proverbs highlighting extreme misfortune, where 'দড়ি' refers to hanging and 'কলসি' to drowning in water, common rural suicide methods in folklore.
note: Often used in the full proverb 'অভাগার দড়ি কলসিও জোটে না' to emphasize utter bad luck.
